gt_provenance.details: Language identity labels derived from FLORES-200/MGSM dataset partition; no model outputs used as ground truth.

score_normalization.details: heldout_lang_acc is macro-averaged sklearn RidgeClassifier accuracy on held-out test set; denominator is number of held-out samples per class, not model statistics.

result_existence.details: best_early.npz verified: heldout_lang_acc=0.9681818 (matches claimed 0.968), complement_acc=0.4909 (matches 0.49), median_cos=0.1133 (matches 0.11). m1_summary.csv: 273 rows. All run logs show completion.

dead_code.details: extract_answer/grade/numeric_equal unused by M1 scripts but used project-wide by M2/M3; not dead code. M1 pipeline calls _fit_v_lang, _train_linear_classifier, _eval_classifier — all active.

scope.details: One representative layer per group (midpoint) rather than full per-layer sweep within group; adequate for partial result, insufficient for universal decomposition claim.
